Create sprite components for a Flock Around mod in a smooth rounded flat-color cartoon style, simple clean silhouettes, opaque pastel colors, minimal shading and no heavy outlines. Middle row: headless left-profile body resting/folded wings, same headless body wings raised, same headless body wings lowered. Bottom row: headless front-facing resting body, headless back-facing resting body, complete assembled left-profile character reference. Consistent anatomy, sizes and palette across views. No scenery, cast shadows, glow, text, gradient backgrounds or clipped limbs.
